content: प्रातिभाव्यम् .²1 Becoming bail or security, suretyship, becoming answerable for the appearance of a debtor, for his being trustworthy, and for paying his debt; श्रेणीप्रातिभाव्येनातिष्ठत् <ls>Dk.</ls>; <ls>Ms. 8. 159</ls>. .²2 Opposition (विरोध); न दुर्बलः प्रातिभाव्यं करोति <ls>Mb. 5. 33. 110</ls>.
